purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0091 in the gauge arena: the quenched rho stays heavy as the pion becomes light, the J parameter maps onto the published quenched world value including its known miss of experiment, and $m_N / m_{\rho}$ is carried to the physical point along an eight-mass Edinburgh plot and reported against the quenched continuum values, not gated.
